[LSER.13.5] **A series is declared by the `series_decl` production of
[LGRA.7.1]**, whose productions are the grammar's: a slot reference, optional
block options (`by:`, `capacity:`, `nulls:`), and one or more series lines,
each an aggregation list, a time model, an optional gap policy
([LSER.13.5.1]) and an optional `as` label.
